description:
**Job Description:** **Our Mission:**


We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.


**About Us:**


Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.


Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.


**Position Summary:**


Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**

* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.

**Test Strategy \& Coverage**

* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.

**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**

* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.

**Functional \& Workflow Testing**

* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.

**XML and Publishing Validation**

* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.

**Data Layer Testing**

* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.

**API and Integration Testing**

* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.

**Performance and Reliability Testing**

* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.

**Collaboration \& Execution**

* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.

 **Experience and Skills:**

**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications**:


* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education: MCA / Bachelor's in Engineering (Computer Science or equivalent).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation.
* Strong API and database testing expertise (REST, SOAP, SQL, MarkLogic, NoSQL).
* Accessibility testing knowledge (WCAG \& EAA compliance).
* Proficiency with Git and version control systems.
* Experience working with structured content publishing ecosystems, including localization, translation management, or content delivery platforms.
* Exposure to cloud\-based testing environments (AWS/Azure).
* Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes) for test execution.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals (OWASP).

title: Connectivity System Integration Senior Engineer
description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.



Caterpillar’s Connectivity System Team is hiring a **Connectivity System Senior Engineer (System Integration / Product Owner)** with expertise in telematics, connectivity platforms, and system integration across embedded and enterprise systems.



In this role, you will work on highly complex and scalable connectivity solutions spanning across CAT and non\-CAT assets. This role combines **system integration engineering and product ownership**, requiring end\-to\-end ownership of connectivity features across embedded systems, connectivity layers, and enterprise/cloud ecosystems.



You will collaborate with global teams including Product Groups (RI, CI, P\&E), Intelligent Machine Systems (IMS), Cat Digital, and platform teams to deliver high\-quality, data\-driven connectivity solutions aligned with customer and business needs.


**What You’ll Do (Job Duties)**


* Own and manage **connectivity features**, driving end\-to\-end lifecycle from requirements definition, system design, integration, validation, and release
* Drive **end\-to\-end system integration** across embedded systems, connectivity modules (5G/LTE, Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth), and enterprise/cloud platforms, ensuring consistent system behavior and readiness
* Act as a **Product Owner**, maintaining and prioritizing feature backlog (WSJF or similar), leading backlog grooming, and ensuring alignment with business priorities and system architecture
* Define and manage **system and feature requirements (SRS/MFRD)** with full traceability across system, software, and validation
* Collaborate with **product teams, Cat Digital, architects, and onboard/offboard engineering teams** to deliver scalable connectivity solutions aligned with customer use cases
* Lead **system validation and quality assurance**, ensuring full feature coverage, production readiness, and robust integration across all subsystems
* Perform **deep system\-level debugging and root cause analysis** across embedded, connectivity, and cloud layers to resolve complex issues
* Apply **DFMEA and Built\-In Quality (BIQ) practices** to proactively identify risks and ensure high system reliability
* Drive **data\-driven decision making** using validation data, system insights, and field feedback to continuously improve performance and quality
* Support **release management**, including Go/No\-Go decisions, release readiness, and tracking feature delivery


**Skill Descriptors**


**Analytical Thinking:** Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.



Level: Extensive Experience


* Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances.
* Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
* Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
* Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.


**Effective Communications:** Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviours.

You'll also have the opportunity to perform installs, moves, adds, and changes (IMAC) activities, as well as data backup and restore on certain accounts for clients, ensuring that all related administrative duties are completed within Service Level Agreement objectives.
  

  

You will develop a deep understanding of the local and regional infrastructure, as well as key contacts in other competencies, which will enable you to ensure that the proper team is aware of – and taking action on the problem.

Imagine being part of a dynamic team that values your growth and development. As Technical Support at Kyndryl, you'll receive an extensive and diverse set of technical trainings, including cloud technology, and free certifications to enhance your skills and expertise. You'll have the opportunity to pursue a career in advanced technical roles and beyond – taking your future to the next level. With Kyndryl, the sky's the limit.  



  

**Who You Are**

**Job Description** :


**Role** : Workplace Virtualization Services – Azure Virtual Desktop with FSLogix, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Monitor and Windows 365


This role is performed by technical professionals who have expertise in designing, deploying, operating and supporting Azure Virtual Desktop environments and related Microsoft cloud services. The scope of this job role includes preparation for new or changed virtual desktop services, management of host pools, session hosts, images, user profiles, application delivery, monitoring, security controls, performance optimization and operational support. Individuals in this role apply their technical skills to maintain reliable, secure and scalable virtual desktop services, troubleshoot critical production issues and support client requirements within agreed service levels.


**Mandatory Skill:**

**Azure Platform**

**Desktop Virtualization**

**Security / Operations**

Azure Virtual Machines


Azure Virtual Desktop Host Pools


Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC


Azure Storage / Azure Files


FSLogix Profile Containers


Azure Monitor / Log Analytics


Azure Networking / NSG


RemoteApp / Application Groups


Autoscale / Scaling Plans


Azure Image Gallery


Windows 11 Multi\-session


Intune / Defender


**Language Skills:** English Language


**Core Job Requirements:**

* Extensive expertise in Azure Virtual Desktop administration, including host pools, workspaces, application groups and session hosts.
* Ability to troubleshoot, identify and resolve virtual desktop, profile, application, connectivity and performance issues.
* Working with service management requests, incidents and changes, responding and resolving within the required SLA.
* Interacting with clients to understand business requirements and support secure remote desktop and application delivery.
* Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure, Windows client/server operating systems, identity, networking, storage and application deployments.

**Required (Primary) Skills:**

**Azure Virtual Desktop Administration**

* Hands\-on experience in Azure Virtual Desktop administration, including pooled and personal host pools, session hosts, workspaces and application groups.
* Install, configure and maintain scalable and highly available Azure Virtual Desktop environments on Microsoft Azure.
* Create, update and maintain golden images using Azure Image Gallery, custom images and image management best practices.
* Deploy and manage session host virtual machines, host pool scaling plans, autoscale settings and Start VM on Connect.
* Configure and troubleshoot FSLogix profile containers using Azure Files or Azure NetApp Files storage options.
* Configure user assignments, RemoteApp publishing, desktop application groups and workspace access.
* Manage Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, RBAC, Conditional Access, MFA and identity\-based access controls for AVD users.
* Configure Azure networking components including virtual networks, subnets, network security groups, routing and firewall rules.
* Monitor AVD health and performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, diagnostic settings and native AVD insights.
* Troubleshoot user login failures, disconnected sessions, profile load issues, latency, application launch failures and session host availability issues.
* Perform daily administration, patching, image updates, host maintenance, security configuration and service improvements.
* Support Windows 10/11 Enterprise multi\-session, Windows Server session hosts and Microsoft 365 Apps in virtual desktop environments.
* Participate in capacity planning, cost optimization, performance tuning, BCP/DR planning and operational readiness activities.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills and ability to resolve issues as per agreed SLA.
* Participate in after\-hours on\-call support rotation and collaborate with Microsoft support for critical production issues when required.

**Azure Platform, Security and Automation**

* Administration and troubleshooting of Azure compute, storage, networking, identity and governance components used by AVD.
* Perform daily administration, maintenance, upgrades, patching, host pool updates and security hardening activities.
* Configure Azure Virtual Networks, private endpoints, NSGs, DNS, routing, VPN/ExpressRoute connectivity and firewall access where required.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, logging and reporting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and AVD Insights.
* Manage backup, recovery, high availability and disaster recovery requirements for AVD supporting services.
* Use PowerShell, Azure CLI, ARM templates, Bicep or Terraform for deployment automation and repeatable operations.
* Optimize compute, storage and session density to improve user experience and reduce operational cost.

**Preferred Skills:**

**Windows Client, Server and Endpoint Management**

* Manage and monitor Windows 11 Enterprise multi\-session, Windows Server and Microsoft 365 Apps in AVD environments.
* Implement, manage, monitor and troubleshoot Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, Organizational Units, Certificates, DHCP and DNS.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, endpoint compliance, application deployment, Defender for Endpoint and Windows update management.
* Knowledge of printer configuration, profile management, application compatibility and end\-user experience optimization in virtual desktop environments.

**Monitoring, Reporting and Operational Excellence**

* Implement, manage and monitor AVD infrastructure using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, diagnostic settings and AVD Insights.
* Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, SOPs and service improvement plans.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes, ServiceNow or similar ticketing tools, change management and incident management.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty, Azure Administrator Associate or equivalent certification are preferred.

**Sr, SME / Architect – Azure Virtual Desktop:**

* Design end\-to\-end Azure Virtual Desktop solutions aligned with business requirements, security standards, user personas, application needs and operational objectives.
* Define architecture for host pools, session host sizing, image management, FSLogix profile storage, networking, identity, access controls, monitoring and backup requirements.
* Develop high\-level and low\-level design documents, build guides, migration plans, operational handover documents and architecture decision records.
* Establish best practices for resilience, scalability, security, conditional access, data protection, cost governance and user experience optimization.
* Lead solution reviews, technical workshops, design discussions, proof of concepts and transition planning with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Provide architecture guidance for integration with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Files, Azure NetApp Files and automation platforms.
Ensure solution designs meet enterprise standards for availability, performance, compliance, supportability, operational readiness and long\-term service improvement.  
* 

  

* 12\+ years of experience in Customer Service or Technical Support
* Experience with Virtualization techn and Azure technologies

  

  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience
  

  

Azure Virtualization desktop  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. JR112042**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**

  

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

  

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.

 **About the Team**


The Genesys Global Security, Privacy \& Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) provides expert security advisory services to Sales, Pre\-Sales, Customers, and Partners. The team serves as the single point of contact for all security, privacy, and compliance\-related customer engagements within the Genesys Cloud Business Unit.

**Role Summary**


We are seeking an experienced Senior or Principal **Cloud Security Architect** to join the Genesys Global Security, Privacy \& Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) as a technical Security Subject Matter Expert (SME). This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing technical security role, not a compliance or GRC position. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Security, and Architecture teams to support consulting, customer audits, security assessments, technical reviews, executive briefings, and evidence\-based engagements for Genesys Cloud.


As one of the team's technical security SMEs, you will apply your expertise in cloud security, AI security, and security controls to explain and defend the Genesys Cloud security, privacy, and compliance posture. You will interpret technical evidence, respond to complex security inquiries, defend security contractual terms, and engage directly with customers, partners, auditors, and executive stakeholders within the APAC region.


This role is highly consultative and requires excellent English communication and presentation skills. You will regularly represent Genesys Cloud during customer executive briefings, security workshops, webinars, conferences, partner events, and industry forums. You must be comfortable presenting complex technical security concepts to audiences ranging from security practitioners and architects to CISOs, CIOs, and other senior executives, both remotely and in person, to any of our global customers.

* Exposure to complex enterprise cloud environments and leading global customer security organisations.
* The opportunity to shape customer trust in Genesys Cloud and its AI capabilities through technical assurance, executive engagement, and industry representation.

* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS security, cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and DevSecOps practices.
* Strong vulnerability\-management and application\-security expertise, including penetration testing, secure SDLC, CI/CD security, SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, Infrastructure as Code security, remediation, and risk\-based prioritisation.
* Proven experience with AI technologies and AI security, including generative AI, large language models, AI governance, AI risk management, and emerging Frontier AI threats to AI\-enabled platforms.

* Experience securing microservices and cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with security automation, detection engineering, or modern Security Operations.
* Professional speaking experience at conferences, webinars, customer events, or technical forums.

* Experience supporting regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, government, or critical infrastructure.
* Fluency in an additional language, preferably Japanese or Korean.
